title: HtmlDl
responsibility: Renders the native dl element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlDl.attributes
inputs.description: Native dl attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlDl.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native dl element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlDl
outputs.description: The actual native dl element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
